synopsis: Southborough boards addressed major commercial development plans and preparations for the upcoming Special Town Meeting this week. The Planning Board opened a public hearing on a proposal for a 167,000-square-foot Costco warehouse and 30-position gas station on Coslin Drive, hearing initial resident traffic concerns, while also advancing discussions on a two-family dwelling zoning amendment. Meanwhile, the Trails Committee evaluated funding alternatives to salvage Community Preservation Act support for the Peninsula Trail pedestrian bridge on the town warrant following negative recommendations from other town boards. Officials also noted an upcoming multi-board session to review elementary school building project options and costs.

highlights.title: Costco warehouse and gas station proposal on Coslin Drive
highlights.why: Costco Wholesale presented site, stormwater, and traffic plans for a proposed 167,000-square-foot warehouse and 30-position fueling station at 21 Coslin Drive, drawing neighborhood concerns regarding traffic on Route 9 and surrounding roads. The Planning Board voted 4-0 to continue the hearing to October 19.

highlights.title: Funding strategy for Peninsula Trail pedestrian bridge
highlights.why: After the Select Board and Advisory Committee voted not to recommend Warrant Article 4, the Trails Committee discussed offering a floor amendment at Special Town Meeting to request $25,000 in new CPA funds while repurposing $211,000 in existing CPA allocations and seeking a state grant.

highlights.title: Two-family dwelling zoning bylaw revisions
highlights.why: The Planning Board reviewed draft revisions to a proposed zoning bylaw amendment governing two-family dwellings, focusing on removing confusing terms and clarifying minimum lot size rules across commercial and industrial districts. The hearing was continued to October 17.

highlights.title: Multi-board briefing on elementary school building options
highlights.why: The town planner reported that a joint meeting with the Elementary School Building Committee and other town boards is scheduled for October 8 to review project options and cost estimates.

looking_ahead.what: Joint meeting with Elementary School Building Committee and town boards on school project options and costs
